svg.text: One notebook per owner, shared across web, Telegram and Slack DMs. Who may see a note is decided inside the SQL query, before the prompt is built.
knowledge/learn.py extracts facts after the reply; "remember that
knowledge/ingest.py: facts keep their source; removing a file
Only if CONNECTOR_FACTS_ENABLED: up to 3 short facts, never raw
Correct (new row, old row ends), forget, or lock a fact
Never write owner facts. Conflicts wait for the owner
allowed_kind: persons, org or public. allowed_person_ids.
min_trust. Owner facts are persons = [owner] unless marked
category, source, trust_rank (owner > document > link > third
party > web), belief_state fact or hearsay
valid_from and valid_to, importance, time-bound decay (14 day
One vector per fact and model; local embedder by default. Without
Full-text AND, then OR (UK and US spelling, synonyms), plus trigram
pgvector nearest neighbours in the same SELECT
public always passes; org only if everyone present is internal; persons only if all present are
allowed; unknown people present means public only. Expired and conflicting notes are excluded
Reciprocal rank fusion, times importance. Code also pre-recalls 4 notes before the model runs
Visible memories go into the prompt
Owner DM on web, Telegram or Slack
Owner mentions Ava in a shared Slack channel
A stranger like Meera, with the receptionist
Sleep job (SLEEP_JOB_ENABLED, off by default): nightly it cuts the day into episodes and merges exact and near-duplicate notes. The
small model only judges pairs; code decides what is retired, at most a quarter a night, with a pre-image saved so it can be undone.
Erase: deleting a document deletes its chunks and the facts only it supported; erasing a third party removes notes about them and
empties their message text. Echo filter (off by default): facts heard via links, Telegram or Slack stay hearsay until a second
independent origin or the owner confirms.
